definitions.explanation: The lower side or underside of something — the surface, region, or portion that is oriented downward, or that lies below a reference point. Contrasts with {上側|うわがわ} (upper side).

examples.japanese: {箱|はこ}の{下側|したがわ}を{見|み}て。
examples.english: Look at the underside of the box.

examples.japanese: スイッチは{本体|ほんたい}の{下側|したがわ}についている。
examples.english: The switch is on the underside of the unit.

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}の{下側|したがわ}に{撮影日|さつえいび}が{小|ちい}さく{印字|いんじ}されている。
examples.english: The date the photo was taken is printed in small characters on the bottom side of the picture.

notes:
Composed of {下|した} ("lower, below") + {側|がわ} ("side"). The {〜側|がわ} suffix forms "side" nouns from direction/position words: {上側|うわがわ} (upper side), {右側|みぎがわ} (right side), {左側|ひだりがわ} (left side), {内側|うちがわ} (inside), {外側|そとがわ} (outside).

USAGE:
- Describes either the lower surface of a single object (the underside of a box, the bottom of a shelf) or the lower region of a larger area (the bottom part of a page or image).
- Typically used with の to link to what it is the underside of: {テーブル|てーぶる}の{下側|したがわ} (the underside of the table).
- Also used relatively, to describe what lies below a reference line or object: {道路|どうろ}の{下側|したがわ} (below the road).
- Near-synonym of {下面|かめん} (lower surface, lower face), but {下側|したがわ} is more conversational and more about orientation than surface geometry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下側|したがわ}に{ある|ある}: to be on the underside / lower side
- {下側|したがわ}を{見|み}る: to look at the underside
- {下側|したがわ}から: from the underside / from below
- {下側|したがわ}の{面|めん}: the lower surface
- {画面|がめん}の{下側|したがわ}: the lower part of the screen

ANTONYM:
- {上側|うわがわ}: upper side, top side — the opposite position or surface.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {下|した}: below, bottom — the basic positional noun; more general and can be used where {下側|したがわ} would feel heavy.
- {裏側|うらがわ}: back side, reverse side — emphasizes "the other side / behind," not "lower."
- {底|そこ}: bottom — the innermost/lowest interior, as of a container.
- {下面|かめん}: lower surface, underside — more technical/written register.
